english.title: Fail to allow an authorised officer of local authority / proper officer access to work on / repair a drain
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to permit **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), the proper or authorised officer of **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..), to have free access to work being executed to

(A)_[repair a]_
(B)_[reconstruct a]_
(C)_[alter the course of a]_
(D)_[cover over a sewer or]_

drain as described in section 61 of the Building Act 1984
english.legislation: Contrary to section 61(2) and (3) of the Building Act 1984.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This section does not apply to-
(a) so much of a drain or sewer constructed by, or belonging to, a railway company as runs under across or along their railway, or
(b) so much of a drain or sewer constructed by, or belonging to, dock undertakers, as is situated in or on land of the undertakers that is held or used by them for the purposes of their undertaking
